key_insight: GALÆXI shows that a DGSEM-based CFD solver can be adapted to heterogeneous AMD MI300A APUs while retaining accuracy for turbulent, shock-containing flows.
engineering_relevance: This work matters because it demonstrates a pathway to exascale-ready large eddy simulation on modern GPU-CPU hybrid hardware without sacrificing physical fidelity.
method: Optimize the architecture-agnostic DGSEM framework for AMD MI300A APU execution
Integrate wall-modeled LES algorithms into the GPU-accelerated solver
Validate with a plane turbulent channel and a wall-resolved transonic compressor cascade
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong and weak scaling studies, compute-partitioning evaluations on Hunter’s MI300A APUs, and validation against channel-flow and compressor-cascade cases.
watch_item: Performance and portability may depend on APU partitioning mode and on careful tuning of wall-model and shock-capturing implementations.
paper_title: APU-Accelerated Large Eddy Simulation with the Discontinuous Galerkin Solver GALÆXI
